name: Bralette
description: Uruguayan lingerie brand selling bralettes, sets, bodysuits, panties and accessories online. Ships to the whole country and offers free pickup at its Montevideo atelier.
description_es: Marca uruguaya de lencería que vende online bralettes, conjuntos, bodys, bombachas y accesorios. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro sin costo en su atelier de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide delivery with free shipping over a purchase threshold; items ship through carriers such as DAC, per the store's delivery page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at its atelier in Punta Carretas, Montevideo.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shopify storefront. Some items are made to order, so the delivery page lists production times separately from carrier delivery.

sources.supports: Delivery times, nationwide free shipping banner and atelier pickup
